title: Team Management & Department Admin (HOD) Delegation
subtitle: Roles, Department Scoping, Invite Codes
overview: Team management is role-aware. A Safety Manager (TENANT_ADMIN or the legacy AIRLINE_ADMIN) manages the whole organisation, while a Department Admin / Head of Department (DEPT_ADMIN) is scoped to a single department.
Every new team member joins through an invite code. Scoped invites bind the invitee's department AND role directly from the invite document at the moment they join.

method.title: Method & Scoring Rules
paragraphs: Safety Manager (TENANT_ADMIN / AIRLINE_ADMIN) — can invite users into any applicable department with any role (DEPT_ADMIN, SAFETY_OFFICER, STAFF), sees every department's members, and manages all invites.

Department Admin (DEPT_ADMIN / HOD) — scoped to their own department only: can invite STAFF into that department, and only sees their own department's members. Cross-department invites and granting DEPT_ADMIN / TENANT_ADMIN roles are denied.
STAFF / USER — least-privilege members who cannot invite.
Invite codes are single-use; a scoped invite carries tenant_id, department, department_label and role, and its status moves from ACTIVE to USED on join.
bullets: Department labels are humanised automatically (e.g. flight_ops → Flight Operations, camo → CAMO).
Part-145 (145…) and CAMO (camo…) email accounts are additionally restricted to their own department's records.
Codes are unique per tenant; joining with an inactive or unknown code is rejected.

mapping.title: CAR-19 / Appendix 10 Mapping
paragraphs: Clear accountabilities support CAAN Appendix 10 Component 1 — Safety Policy & Objectives: defined safety accountabilities, key safety personnel, and documented responsibilities.
Least-privilege role assignment is part of Safety Assurance (Component 3) governance controls.

example.title: Worked Example
paragraphs: The CAMO Safety Manager (TENANT_ADMIN) invites the CAMO HOD as a DEPT_ADMIN and a storekeeper as STAFF.
The CAMO HOD then invites a new engineer into CAMO only — this succeeds.
If the CAMO HOD tries to invite a pilot into Flight Operations, or to grant DEPT_ADMIN, the request is rejected with 403 — department and role authority are enforced server-side.
The pilot joins Flight Operations later via a scoped invite created by the Safety Manager; their department and role are bound from the invite at join time.
